query:
SELECT e.inep, e.nome, e.status AS escola_status, e.dataConclusao AS escola_dataConclusao,
       os.id AS os_id, os.status AS os_status, os.dataConclusao AS os_dataConclusao,
       os.qtdApInstalado, os.observacao, os.tecnicoId
FROM escolas e
LEFT JOIN ordens_servico os ON os.escolaId = e.id
WHERE e.inep IN ('29132967', '29757622')
ORDER BY e.inep, os.id;
